annotations.annotation_text: The Letter motif "letter" on page 337 ("The Tavern"): ALP's mysterious document — scratched from the midden by Biddy Doran the Hen — represents the genesis of all writing within HCE behind the bar at his Chapelizod pub, the Norwegian Captain tale, the television broadcast, the twelve customers drinking and judging. During this Age of Heroes phase, the letter functions simultaneously as archaeological artifact, love note, legal deposition, and the text of Finnegans Wake itself.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Deane, Vincent, et al. The Finnegans Wake Notebooks at Buffalo. https://www.brepols.net

annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "night" on page 337 ("The Tavern"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within HCE behind the bar at his Chapelizod pub, the Norwegian Captain tale, the television broadcast, the twelve customers drinking and judging. During this Age of Heroes phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349
Troy, Mark L. Mummeries of Resurrection. http://www.rosenlake.net
